info.bio:
B.E.P es una de las bandas más vendedoras de  la actualidad, al haber rebasado la cifra de 33 millones de discos y más de 40 millones de singles en todo el  mundo. De hecho son uno de los grupos más populares del planeta y han estado de gira en más países que ninguna otra banda.
will.i.am no sólo es el  MC líder y motor creativo del grupo. También diseña, es actor, activista social, y un solicitadísimo productor musical que ha trabajado con la crème de la crème del mundo musical, de U2 a Nas pasando por  Flo Rida.

podcast.title: Fergie Joins the Band (1999)
podcast.body: While playing the Warped Tour in 1999, the group met Fergie in the parking lot. They got along so well that they asked her to join the band. "They got along so well that they asked her to join the band."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Highest Concert Record (2009)
podcast.body: On September 8, 2009, The Black Eyed Peas achieved a new record for the highest concert. They performed aboard a Virgin Blue Boeing 737, flying from Melbourne, Australia, to Perth, reaching an altitude of 41,000 feet during their mid-flight performance. "On September 8, 2009, the Black Eyed P's got aboard a Virgin Blue 737 in Melbourne, Australia, and flew to an altitude of 41,000 feet on their way to Perth. They played during the flight, giving them the record."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Embracing Dance Music with Eurodance Elements
podcast.body: The Black Eyed Peas, originating from the realm of "black music," made a notable transition to dance music. They incorporated structural elements akin to Eurodance, a move that led to their chart-topping success in the United States. "...artistas que venían de la música negra como Black and P..."

podcast.title: Songs About Jeffrey Dahmer
podcast.body: The Black Eyed Peas are included in the list of artists who have written songs about the serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer. "Jeffrey Dahmer seems to have the most songs written about him with about 50 Pearl Jam, Slayer, Black Eyed Peas, Katy Perry, Eminem, Dr. Dre, Violent Femmes, J. Cole and many more."
